lines.text: A supply boat has reached Greenlight's pier. Driftwood has jammed the inner support and loosened its rail.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The cargo can wait. One careful helper can pass, but that loose support will not take the crew together.

lines.speaker: Landing clerk
lines.text: But this cargo was signed in yesterday. These are the same seals.

lines.speaker: Dock foreman
lines.text: Then yesterday can lend us a hand. My injured worker is waiting farther out on the pier.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Check the jammed support at the pier mouth. Keep to the narrow pedestrian lane.
You examine the lodged driftwood and the loose pier support.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: A helper can pass, but the crew needs bracing, a secured handline, or an escort one at a time.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: What will you do?

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Your next work site is marked. We will follow your lead.
The crew gathers around Odo to plan a safe rescue.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: You have seen the damage. How will you help get everyone clear?

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Your next work site is marked. We will follow your lead.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Every worker is accounted for. Now we can ask why two orders claim the same cargo.

lines.speaker: Dock foreman
lines.text: Everyone is clear of the damaged landing. The medical chest and the pump crate are still waiting by the quay.

variants.medical: The dry medical chest comes first. The pump crate will wait in salvage holding.
variants.pump: The pump fittings come first. The care station will draw on its emergency reserve.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The seals agree. The cargo and the witnesses do not.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Keep the independent account. A claim on paper cannot make one fitting serve two works.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: Keep the crew clear. I can hold the bypass.
Voss stays at the work while the crew withdraws. The salvaged equipment can now be installed.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Our crew will hold the bypass while we take the reading.

variants.medical: Your medical chest is ready. We will hold a crew-operated bypass until the fittings are recovered.
variants.pump: Your pump fittings are ready. The care station has used its reserve; the test mechanism can now work properly.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Try the marked gauge yourself. Then decide who should see the account.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: We have a reading, witnesses, and your decision. That is an account worth keeping.
The first emergency is over. Your work and chosen account have been recorded.
At the private test work, a stranded crew waits beyond a bypass that will not stay open.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: Leave the part alone. Brace this bypass and get the crew clear first.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: I will show the controls. You can hold the approach or help the work. Keep a safe way back.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Check the bypass, secure its brace, then release the crew. We fit the salvaged equipment after everyone is safe.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: The brace is holding. Go now; I am staying here until you are clear.

lines.speaker: Works Hand
lines.text: Across and safe. Nobody left behind.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Now we can install the salvaged part and make an honest test.

variants.medical: Your medical reserve is ready. The crew will operate a braced bypass while we test the work.
variants.pump: The pump fitting you saved can now be installed. The care station has spent its reserve.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The intake and diversion do different jobs. Watch the water, then compare the independent gauge.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The stream tells you what the controls are doing. The gauge supplies an independent comparison.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: A mark in the permitted column is a claim. A reading you can reproduce is evidence.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Record the result you observed. Then decide how this account should be shared.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: The crew is safe and the test can be repeated. Your chosen account stays with the evidence.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: Then put down what happened here, including what it cost.
Party members choose individually whether to record this outcome. Helping another expedition does not overwrite your own story.

lines.speaker: Ammet Sorrel
lines.text: You call it temporary, Odo. The shortage still reaches my roots.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: I kept the crew's intake open. I didn't tell you what that left for the grove.

lines.speaker: Ammet Sorrel
lines.text: Then give me an account I can check: which load, which route, and who pays to put it right.

variants.public: Public numbers aren't enough. Show which work took the load, and what it cost the grove.
variants.protected: Keep your witness unnamed. Give me an account I can check on the ground.
variants.supervised: I'll hear a witnessed account. Show the work and write down the grove's cost.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Choose a way across. We'll follow the marks and test the diversion together.

lines.speaker: Ammet Sorrel
lines.text: A route is a plan until you have walked it.

variants.detour: The long bank keeps the supplies in reserve. Follow its bends and check where the wheels return.
variants.planks: Two wooden planks can make this crossing. Fit them at the work site before you try the span.
variants.secure: That shorter approach needs both anchors secured. Inspect them and make the path safe before you use it.

lines.speaker: Ammet Sorrel
lines.text: This scrape is one observation. Look for the packing and the changed channel; the permit is only a claim.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: We can test the water once you have marked the actual destination.

lines.speaker: Grove Works Hand
lines.text: Odo's castle sluice is a separate job. This new cut is taking the grove's water; let's test it.

lines.speaker: Grove Works Hand
lines.text: Open the intake alone and read the unsteady mark. Then open the return and take a steady reading. Try both yourself.

lines.speaker: Grove Works Hand
lines.text: Two is the permitted claim. One steady supply is what this work can reproduce.

lines.speaker: Grove Works Hand
lines.text: After the test, choose the cost: the grove reserve, a replacement board, or an extra maintenance shift. Then do that work.

lines.speaker: Ammet Sorrel
lines.text: The remedy is in place. Keep its cost with the account.

variants.reserve: The grove reserve has been spent. The work holds, and that reserve now needs replacing.
variants.material: The replacement is fitted. One wooden plank is in the work rather than in your pack.
variants.maintenance: Both crew checks are done. The work holds because a maintenance shift has been assigned.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Start with the delivered load. Walk back towards the changed intake, placing removable markers as the evidence supports them.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: I will walk with you. If a marker contradicts the traces, lift that marker and correct it. We keep what you already verified.
Return to play to reconstruct the route. Watching this account does not place a marker or finish the walk.

measure.bank.resolved.title: An Account of the Other Bank

lines.speaker: Ammet Sorrel
lines.text: The permit describes a different job. The route and the water can now be checked by another pair of hands.

variants.custodian: The local custodians will keep the independent account, including the reserve, boards or shifts the work consumed.
variants.public: The verified route will go before a public inspection. The work and its cost can be challenged in the open.
variants.protected: The witness stays protected. The measured route remains on record, with that limit stated plainly.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Oyun counted the workers who actually arrived. Her record may tell us which job these loads supplied.
Each party member decides whether this outcome becomes their own story. Helping this work preserves an uncommitted personal account.

lines.speaker: Oyun Tarag
lines.text: I fed six workers. These permits claim twelve. The road cannot eat a name on paper.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Then count the hands and the loads separately. Tell us what moved, and who was left carrying it.

lines.speaker: Farm Works Hand
lines.text: We shifted extra loads without changing the papers. Brace the rear, protect the supplies, or share the weight.

lines.speaker: Oyun Tarag
lines.text: You are free to leave, guests. Soup buys no service here. Keep two bowls for whoever reaches us late.
Inspect and prepare both carts in play. The field food is finite; a safe departure can wait.

measure.road.herd.title: The Road Belongs to Them Too

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Crown stags ahead. Hold the carts. They need room to cross, and we need a firm place to stand.

lines.speaker: Farm Works Hand
lines.text: Inspect the stopped load. Anchor it, guide a safe diversion, or take weight off together.
Complete the field work and let the harmless herd clear. Watching this scene does not clear the road.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Our first stop is saved. Softer ground lies ahead; keep watching what the rear cart carries when we reach it.

lines.speaker: Farm Works Hand
lines.text: A brace needs a sound anchor. A diversion needs a guide. Rebalancing means handling the load, not just naming a plan.
Bring the carts to the next safe point in play. Then take the public road through Reedfall to Tobin at Brambleshaw.

lines.speaker: Tobin Ware
lines.text: I can swear how many wheels passed my post. I cannot swear which work received the fitting.

variants.remembered_casks: I remember your boat and toll observations. They are leads, not a claim on the palace stores. This carrier must agree to this inspection.
variants.remembered_palace: You asked about the sealed palace casks before. They stay sealed. Here we need witnessed terms from the current carrier.

lines.speaker: Current Carrier
lines.text: Ask me for witnessed terms on this shipment. If it cannot leave safely, record the safety stop and the reason.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Compare the seal, weight and fittings with the current delivery account. The palace stores remain sealed.

lines.speaker: Tobin Ware
lines.text: I will witness the agreed inspection and custody. My toll post grants no general claim over another person’s cargo.

lines.speaker: Tobin Ware
lines.text: This current shipment has a checkable account and witnessed terms.

variants.witnessed_transfer: This shipment transfers under the carrier’s witnessed agreement. Record its destination and who receives it.
variants.safe_hold: This shipment stays in safe custody under the agreed terms. Record the reason and who may release it.
variants.carrier_return: The carrier takes this shipment back under the witnessed terms, with the delivery account corrected.

lines.speaker: Current Carrier
lines.text: Keep the load, the route and the terms together. A permit is no substitute for the work we actually carried.

lines.speaker: Odo Fenn
lines.text: Edda at Greenlight is asking about the causeway crews. She should hear what these carts and workers proved.
Each party member chooses whether to record this outcome or keep helping without committing their own account.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: Here we can step the work cycle ourselves. Nobody must wait for the tide or the night.

variants.safe_hold: Tobin’s shipment stays under witnessed hold. We will test the equipment already here, with its copied authorization.
variants.carrier_return: The carrier took that consignment back under the recorded terms. This local fixture still needs an independent test.
variants.witnessed_transfer: Your witnessed transfer identifies which fitting was meant for this work. Compare that account with what is actually installed.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: Change one setting. Watch the water mark, the lamp height and the pointer answer it. A bright lamp alone proves little.
Advance, hold and record the controlled test. The words, shapes and readings carry the same information as the light.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: Then the load changes. Use your own readings to choose an interval, and test that prediction in play.

lines.speaker: Teren Wick
lines.text: I can reach the first refuge if someone makes the next stretch safe. Do not send me on a promise from the lamp alone.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: Protect the approach, fit a temporary brace, or work through the marked maintenance bays. I can hold a mechanism you have secured.
A party can divide the work. Alone, direct Edda and move between stable refuges. A setback needs recovery, not a chapter restart.

lines.speaker: Teren Wick
lines.text: I am on safe ground. Keep the refuge marks where the next crew can read them.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: Now make the local equipment safe: isolate it, move it under witness, or protect an independent measurement.
Secure the equipment and the readings before asking who authorized the shortage.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: I moved fittings between urgent jobs. No single office would authorize the whole tradeoff, and I expected the coastal reserve to cover the next gap.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: These readings prove a shortage. They do not prove that the crews agreed to bear it.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: They did not. I hid which crew would wait. Helping at one gate did not make that account honest.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: Choose a public challenge, a protected examination, or limited cooperation under a witnessed condition. The evidence stays safe.

lines.speaker: Edda Tine
lines.text: The work and its account are secured.

variants.public: The crews will challenge the account publicly. The readings and the hidden shortage remain on record.
variants.protected: The examination will protect the witnesses. Record the readings and state plainly what we are withholding.
variants.conditional: Voss may help only under the witnessed condition. No fresh borrowing disappears into an unspoken promise.

lines.speaker: Serit Voss
lines.text: The coast was promised as the remedy. Follow that reserve through the boat accounts; do not take my expectation as a delivery.
Each party member chooses their own account. The service lamp and readable work instructions remain useful optional follow-ups.
